web.title: Coral closes $4.1-million seed round to launch menopause virtual care ...
web.description:
Montréal-based femtech startup [Coral](https://coral.ca/) has raised $4.1-million CAD seed round to address a yawning gap in women’s health care through its menopause virtual care platform.

The all-equity, all-primary round was led by Montréal-based Brightspark Ventures, with participation from Diagram Ventures and women-led venture capital (VC) fund The51.
